principle: Instruction, tutoring and mentorship are separate persistent professional relationships. Mentorship is voluntary and cannot expand formal authority.
rules: An instructor is a persistent character with temporal, assignment and campaign-history validity.
Teaching assignment does not itself create tutoring or mentorship.
Tutoring is academic assistance and does not itself create mentorship.
Mentorship requires represented bilateral acceptance and professional scope.
The player cannot be automatically assigned or auto-accepted into a mentorship.
NPC mentorship acceptance must also be represented rather than inferred from convenience.
Mentor capacity is finite and existing valid mentorships consume capacity first.
Mentorship alone creates no grade, qualification, discipline, friendship, romance, promotion or posting.
Species, sex category, materialization state and player proximity are not mentor-selection shortcuts.
Tutoring/mentoring sessions require real bilateral time, travel and an appropriate location.
A planned session does not assert actual attendance.
Recommendation evidence requires active mentorship, recommendation authority and real basis_event_refs.
Recommendation evidence never guarantees a result.
Academy mentorship does not automatically continue as active-duty mentorship after graduation.
